text.p: Genesis Insurance & Financial Services Inc said it expects to report earnings of $0.14 per share for the 1996 year versus $0.03 in 1995.
The Company said it revised its 1997 earnings estimate to $0.70 from $0.42.

It said the 1997 upward revision was based on potential revenue from the recently announced quota share initiative with La Centro Americana SA, the re-opening project at the Miller Mountain Gold Mine, the recent acquisition of MotorSports Travel Centers, Inc and the effect of the Imagex reorganization plan.

Genesis is a diversified holding company with investments in financial services, medical products, agricultural industry, real estate, gold mining and investments in other hard assets, natural resources, securities and projects.
